page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top centre; page number at top right; a footnote-like line "(***)" and a catchword-like word "Schlick" at the foot right. No margin notes beyond the list entries.

l.i: Neoburgi vel Nevvenburgi Comes ad Danubium.

main_text.l: Neonari vel Nevvenari,id est Nova Aquila Comes.
Oberfteini Comes in Alfatia. Forte, Eberfteini.
main_text.p: Ortenburgt Comes in Bavaria,qui nunc dicuntur Antiquiores Comites de Ortenburg, respectu eorum qui à Carolo V. Imp. creati sub Auftriacis degunt, sed inter Ordines liberos & Comitiales non computantur.
main_text.l: Radenbachi Comes. Forte infra inter Barones, Radenach.
Remonty vel Romuntÿ,id est Rotundimontis Comes in Sabaudia.
Rotenburgi Comes ad Rufam in Helvetia.
Rotenburgi Comes ad Nicrum in Suevia.

page.notes: The page is a printed list of counts of the Holy Roman Empire, in italic names with roman "Comes". Some names are uncertain in the scan (e.g. "Ostfrisia" read as Oftfrisia, "Ortenburgt" as Ortenburg, "Octinga" and "Phirreti"). Mark of "Schlick" at the foot is a signature-like word, treated as catchword. The dagger marks † are printed.
